quick_skim.title: A Physics-Flavored Transformer Network for Parametrizing Contraction Dynamics of Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues
quick_skim.abstract: Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues (ESMs) have become a key structure for biomedical disease modeling and pharmacological screening, yet their functional characterization often relies on simplistic metrics like peak force, discarding critical kinetic information. This is partially due to the high level of mathematical complexity which mechanistic models introduce to capture these dynamics. Hence, exactly the complexity prevents scalable application and widespread adaptation in the field. Here we present a Physics-Flavored Neural Network (PFNN) that automates the kinetic phenotyping of ESMs. Our architecture integrates a stretched-exponential physical model into a CNN-Transformer, enabling the extraction of physically meaningful parameters directly from force-time profiles. To address the scarcity of labeled biological data, we employ a hybrid training paradigm: the model develops a "physical intuition" on synthetic data before undergoing unsupervised self-alignment on unlabeled real-world measurements. Our results demonstrate that this physics-flavored approach achieves high-fidelity parameterization across diverse contractile phenotypes and cell lines, including Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy models. Our scalable, self-improving pipeline bridges the gap between idealized biophysics and noisy \emph{in vitro} data, providing a robust tool for high-throughput biophysical research.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 工程化骨骼肌组织是疾病建模和药物筛选的重要平台，但其功能刻画常仅使用峰值力等简化指标，丢失了关键的动力学信息。作者提出物理风味神经网络PFNN，将拉伸指数物理模型嵌入CNN-Transformer，实现组织收缩动力学的自动化表征。该架构能从力曲线中提取动力学参数，避免复杂机理模型带来的高复杂度。该方法有望在药物筛选和疾病建模中实现对肌肉组织反应的高通量、可扩展表征。
